origin.description: Build several formulas that share one response.

arguments.name: .response
arguments.text: A one-sided formula used as every left-hand side.
Named formulas. A later expression can refer to an earlier name.

origin.details: The response must be one-sided. A string that is not itself a formula is evaluated after earlier names are bound, which is how a later formula can call add_predictors.
origin.value: A named list of two-sided formulas.
origin.example: cat(deparse(formulas(~lhs, linear = ~var1 + var2, hierarchical = add_predictors(linear, ~(1 | group)))$hierarchical), "\n")
